cli.usage:
Usage:
  xorway [options]          run the daemon (system tray icon)
  xorway install [--no-autostart]
                            install this binary for the current user
                            (~/.local/bin, launcher, autostart)
  xorway uninstall          uninstall (the configuration is kept)
  xorway version            print the version

Daemon options:
cli.flag.backend: backend to use: auto, kwin, x11
cli.flag.no_autostart: do not start XorWay when the session opens
install.done: XorWay is installed. Start it from the application menu or with “xorway”.
install.uninstalled: XorWay is uninstalled. Quit the running instance from its menu if needed.
